about: Regular oral prednisolone for rheumatoid arthritis spans January to May before the documented abatacept infusion on 15 May.

Possible finding: the February to June oral steroid course spans more than 90 days, but its indication and any rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis are unknown, and the July pack is a short course for asthma.
Rheumatoid arthritis is recorded and prednisolone is supplied for about six months, but Methoblastin (methotrexate) is supplied alongside it, so the steroid is not the only treatment.
